source_lineage.excerpt: This error messag is seen because of some missing Linux libraries. Usually what's missing are the compat-libstdc++ or libstdc++ libraries. Usually the 32-bit version is missing. Use the commands shown below to verify you have them installed, otherwise contact your Linux system administrator and installt these required libraries.

*  Need xterm on TSAM 7.2.1 server -
   
   One of the script changeDirectory.sh require /usr/bin/xterm:
   
   #export DISPLAY=10.96.2.103:0.0 # export
   DEBUG_TSAM_LAUNCHPAD=true #./launchpad.sh + firefox -P Profile_3
   profile /tmp/IBM_LaunchPad_30194/Profile_30194 file: ///opt/IBM/
   files/TivSAM_Base_V721/TSAMBASE7210/launchpad/Mozilla.html
   /tmp/IBM_LaunchPad_30194/changeDirectory.sh: line 16: /usr/bin/x
   le or directory /tmp/IBM_LaunchPad_30194/changeDirectory.sh: lin
   /usr/bin/xterm: No such fi le or directory
   
   After install xterm, lauchpad move on to next step
   
   Please add xterm requirement in TSAM 7.2.1 Installation Guide
   under  Preparing the environment for installation -> Preparing a
   Linux management server -> Installing required packages on a
   Linux Manage Server
   
   http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/tivihelp/v10r1/index.js

http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/tivihelp/v10r1/index.js
   p?topic=%2Fcom.ibm.tsam_7.2.1.2.doc% [http://publib.boulder.ibm.com/infocenter/tivihelp/v10r1/index.jsp?topic=%2Fcom.ibm.tsam_7.2.1.2.doc%]
   2Fc_prep_ms_for_lx_intel_packages.htm
   
   Table 1. Required packages for Linux management servers
   
   For this case, customer is using RHEL5.4-64, xterm installed is
   xterm.x86_64, version 215-8.e15_4.1

Note: IBM Business Process Manager V8.5.5 products use an updated version of the Launchpad and do not have this issue on Mozilla Firefox V18 and later.


Work around for Mozilla Firefox Version 15 and 17 browsers for IBM Business Process Manager V8.0 version
Complete the following steps to work around the problem with the Mozilla Firefox Version 15 and Version 17 browsers: 

 1. Back up the {INSTALL_IMAGE_FILES_DIR}/launchpad/preferences.sh file. For example: cp preferences.sh preferences.sh_org
    
    
 2. Add the following line to the end of the preferences.sh file:
    'user_pref("security.enablePrivilege.enable_for_tests", true);' >>$userprefpath/user.js
    See the following screen shot:
    
    
    [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21643517&aid=2] [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21643517&aid=2]
    
    
 3. Restart the Launchpad.

Alternative workarounds 

 * You can use the IBM Installation Manager to install the product without using the Launchpad. 
   
   
 * Install IBM Business Process Manager silently using the command line or using a response file. For more information, refer to the following product documentation for custom installations:  * Version 8.0.1 [http://pic.dhe.ibm.com/infocenter/dmndhelp/v8r0m1/index.jsp] 
    * Version 8.0 [http://pic.dhe.ibm.com/infocenter/dmndhelp/v8r0mx/index.jsp] 
    * Version 7.5.1 [http://pic.dhe.ibm.com/infocenter/dmndhelp/v7r5m1/index.jsp] 
    * Version 7.5 [http://pic.dhe.ibm.com/infocenter/dmndhelp/v7r5mx/index.jsp]

Make sure that you have write access to the install_image/Launchpad/content/scripts/ folder. Otherwise, the Typical installation cannot update the JDBC driver path and testing the database connection will always fail.


If you have write access, but you entered a valid JDBC driver with an incorrect version and testing the database connection fails, use the following procedure to fix it: 

 1. Go to install_image/Launchpad/content/scripts/ and delete the four files whose names start with runJavaMethod:
    runJavaMethod.bat, runJavaMethod.sh, runJavaMethod.bat.txt, runJavaMethod.sh.txt 
 2. From installation image disk2, extract the two files runJavaMethod.bat and runJavaMethod.sh from disk2/Launchpad/content/scripts/ to the folder under install_image/Launchpad/content/scripts/ 
 3.  Rerun the Typical installation to provide the correct JDBC driver.

If you once specified the correct version of the JDBC driver path, the "Test Database Connection" step will always succeed, even if you incorrectly change the path later, because the correct JDBC driver path was already added to the classpath. In this unlikely case, the Typical installation will fail at the end when creating a profile.

This common launchpad component is no longer being maintained and will be removed in the next release. To install the product, install Installation Manager from the appropriate "InstallerImage" subdirectory, then install the product by:




 1. Restart Installation Manager 
 2. Select File/Preferences and add the the "disktag.inf" file location as a repository. 
 3. Apply the changes and the product should then be listed as installable when you select the "install" option in Installation Manager.
